scope: Search signed-in users’ durable chats, projects, and project sections from the existing compact workspace search popup.

keep: Existing workspace search trigger, saved records, and open-work links
replace: Local project-name filtering with actual saved workspace search

architecture.reason: Use the existing authenticated browser client and RLS with a pinned in-memory ranker; no search service or durable duplicate index.

schemaImpact.rollout: Uses current tables and owner policies.

auth.description: Uses the existing verified session identity; no new authentication flow.

tenant.description: Additional bounded reads from existing user-owned RLS tables. Every read also filters on the authenticated account ID.

credentials.description: Uses only the current authenticated browser client; no secrets added.

egress.description: Search terms go to Xroga’s existing Supabase origin only. No external index or telemetry.

cost.description: Uses bounded existing database reads and client-side ranking; no model or new search service.

tests.scope: Validate bounded terms, filter construction, ranking, deduplication and safe result shape.

tests.command: GitHub Actions: Isolated Supabase authenticated browser verification
tests.scope: Discover a saved project and chat preview, verify another account’s candidate stays hidden, and reopen the actual chat using the keyboard.

rollout: Run the authenticated isolation tests and existing checks before preview or a separately authorized production release.
rollback: Revert the scoped frontend changes or restore the previous verified deployment; no database changes.
knownGaps: Search covers saved titles, initial prompts, previews, project or repository names and project sections, not full message history or external file content.
Section links open their parent project.

blockers: Exact-source isolated browser verification and release checks required.
